reason: I'd totally impulse-tap a funny duck sock ad, but the second I see 'pre-order, ships once 100 people reserve, no date' I'm out. I already have a drawer of patterned socks, so I'm not paying a deposit to wait an unknown amount of time for more.
objection: No delivery date at all. I pay €4.99 and then what, wait months for socks that might never get made if they don't hit 100?
would_change_my_mind: Having it in stock and shipping now in 2-4 days, or at least a firm delivery date plus an automatic refund if the 100 reservations don't happen.
